cancelFlow.title: Cancel invoice {{number}}
cancelFlow.reasonLabel: Why is this invoice being cancelled?
cancelFlow.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. duplicate invoice, customer cancelled the order
cancelFlow.goodsQuestion: What is happening to the goods?
cancelFlow.goodsIntro: Cancelling the invoice does not move stock on its own. Tell us about the goods so the inventory stays true.

option1.label: The products will be returned
option1.hint: A {{status}} return note is created and linked to this invoice, ready for you to confirm when the goods physically arrive.

option2.label: The products have already been returned
option2.hint: The return note is created and confirmed as of the date below, and the stock comes back immediately.
option2.scope: This covers ALL delivered products on this invoice, and the return note is sealed as soon as you confirm — unlike option 1's {{status}}, it cannot be edited afterwards.
option2.partialPointer: Getting only part of the goods back? Create the return note from Sales → Return notes → New instead.

option3.label: No return — the goods are not coming back

hint.goodsIssued: The goods stay with the customer: no stock comes back and the cost stays charged. This choice is recorded on the invoice.
hint.noGoodsIssued: Nothing was ever delivered against this invoice, so there is nothing to return. This choice is recorded on the invoice.
hint.unknown: Records that no goods come back. We could not confirm this invoice's deliveries yet, so nothing is claimed about them here.

cancelFlow.optionsDisabledReason: No confirmed delivery note is linked to this invoice, so no goods have left your stock and none can come back.
cancelFlow.chooseAnOption: Choose what is happening to the goods before cancelling.

recorded.title: Goods decision recorded
recorded.no_return: No return — the goods stay with the customer.
recorded.no_goods_issued: Nothing was delivered against this invoice.
recorded.not_applicable: This invoice has no physical products.

success.withReturnNote: Invoice cancelled and return note {{number}} created.

errors.DOCUMENT_HAS_PAYMENTS: This invoice cannot be cancelled because payments or credit notes have already been applied to it. Unallocate them first, or issue a credit note instead.
errors.DOCUMENT_PERIOD_CLOSED: This invoice sits in a closed VAT period. Ask your accountant to reopen it, or issue a credit note instead.
errors.DOCUMENT_PERIOD_FILED: This invoice sits in a VAT period that has already been filed, which can never be reopened. Issue a credit note instead.
errors.RETURN_PERIOD_CLOSED: That date falls in a closed VAT period. Pick a date in an open period, or ask your accountant to reopen it.
errors.RETURN_PERIOD_FILED: That date falls in a VAT period already filed with the tax authority, which can never be reopened. Pick a date in an open period.
errors.RETURN_PERIOD_LOCKED: That date falls in a closed or locked accounting period. Pick a date in an open period.
errors.RETURN_NOTHING_DELIVERED: Nothing has been delivered against this invoice that is still available to return. Choose "no return" instead.
errors.RETURN_LOCATION_UNRESOLVED: No confirmed delivery note says which location the goods left from, and guessing one would create stock where it never was. Create the return note manually from the delivery note.
errors.RETURN_LOCATION_AMBIGUOUS: Part of the delivered quantity cannot be matched to the location it left from. Create the return note manually from the delivery note.
errors.RETURN_EXCEEDS_DELIVERED_QUANTITY: The return would exceed what was delivered for {{product}} — only {{remaining}} is still available to return.
errors.RETURN_EXCEEDS_INVOICED_QUANTITY: The return would exceed what was invoiced for {{product}} — only {{remaining}} is still available to return.
errors.RETURN_DECISION_ALREADY_RECORDED: A decision about the goods has already been recorded for this cancellation and cannot be changed.
errors.RETURN_DECISION_FORBIDDEN: You can cancel this invoice, but not record the goods return it needs. Ask a manager to complete the return, or cancel without a return.
errors.unknown: The invoice could not be cancelled. Please try again, or contact support if it keeps happening.
errors.RETURN_DECISION_MISMATCHES_GOODS: This invoice has products on it, so it cannot be cancelled without saying what happens to the goods. Reload the page and choose an option.
errors.futureReturnDate: The return date cannot be in the future.
errors.invalidReturnDate: Enter the return date as a calendar date.
errors.returnDateBeforeInvoice: The return date cannot be earlier than the invoice date.

cancelFlow.optionsUnknownReason: We could not confirm what was delivered on this invoice yet, so a goods return cannot be recorded from here.
cancelFlow.checkFailed: We could not check this invoice. Retry, or reload the page.

preDeliveryInvoicing.alternativesTitle: If the goods have not shipped yet
preDeliveryInvoicing.alternativeOrder: Record a quote or sales order instead, and register any up-front payment as a customer advance. Invoice once the goods are delivered.

preDeliveryInvoicing.blockedNoLocation: No stock location could be resolved for these goods. Set a default location, or a location on the invoice, and try again.

partnerTab.title: Delivery notes
partnerTab.coexistence:
A delivery note is billed once, by whichever route reaches it first.
Bill from the sales order when the whole order goes out and gets invoiced as one job.
Bill from delivery notes when you deliver repeatedly against a standing arrangement and invoice the period.
Once a delivery note is on an invoice it leaves the un-invoiced list and shows which invoice took it.
